# ETH-USD — Technical Deep Dive (as of 2026-11-14)

**Instrument:** ETH-USD (Ethereum USD, CCC) — crypto asset, 24/7 continuous trading. No company fundamentals apply; this is a pure price/volume/derivatives-structure read.

**Verified close (source of truth — `get_verified_market_snapshot`, 2026-11-14):**
O **1927.41** | H **1933.09** | L **1760.05** | C **1792.42** | Vol **16,309,910,528**

---

## 1. Executive read: a confirmed, accelerating downtrend that is now statistically stretched

ETH-USD closed 2026-11-14 at **1792.42**, down roughly **7.0%** from the prior close of **1927.59** (2026-11-13), and roughly **26.0%** below the 2026-11-04 close of **2422.31**. The session was a wide-range continuation bar: a **173.04** point high-low range (**1.72×** the current ATR of **100.78**) with the close landing in the bottom **18.7%** of that range — i.e., sellers controlled the session into the close.

Three things are simultaneously true, and this is the crux of the setup:

1. **Trend is decisively bearish.** Price sits below every average: 10 EMA (2047.34), 200 SMA (2144.74), VWMA (2140.12), 50 SMA (2395.75) and Bollinger middle (2189.36). All averages are rolling over.
2. **The tape is stretched.** RSI **20.41**, price **4.57%** below the lower Bollinger band (1878.16), ATR at **5.62%** of price. Mean-reversion risk is high.
3. **Momentum has *not* yet turned.** MACD histogram is at **-34.74** — a fresh cycle extreme, *not* a fading one. Both RSI and the histogram printed new cycle lows on 2026-11-14 alongside the new price low. **There is no bullish divergence.**

That third point is what separates this from a textbook oversold entry. Below I show why the histogram extreme in October did *not* mark a bottom, and what the correct trigger sequence is.

---

## 2. Price action structure — a clean staircase of lower highs and lower lows

The recent tape is unusually orderly in its disorder:

**Descending highs:** 2446.05 (2026-11-04) → 2434.43 (11-05) → 2133.85 (11-10) → 2100.61 (11-11) → 2063.39 (11-12) → 2018.65 (11-13) → **1933.09 (11-14)**.

**Descending lows:** 2223.64 (11-04) → 2203.81 (11-05) → 2081.50 (11-08) → 2005.43 (11-10) → 1982.45 (11-12) → 1897.55 (11-13) → **1760.05 (11-14)**.

**The Nov 4–5 bull trap.** On 2026-11-04 ETH-USD surged from 2272.73 to close 2422.31 (high 2446.05, +17.49B volume). The very next session it reversed the entire move, closing 2234.48 (-7.75% from the open of 2422.31) on 18.67B volume. That Nov 4 high was the last local high; everything since is distribution. **The Nov 4–5 whipsaw is the highest-information bar pair in the last six weeks** and defines point of control shifting to the downside.

**Three consecutive down closes** (11-12, 11-13, 11-14) with no meaningful bounce — 2016.83 → 1927.59 → 1792.42. The 1897.55 shelf (11-13 low) has been cleanly broken and closed below.

**Context on the damage:** close of 2776.47 on 2026-09-21 → 1792.42 is **-35.4%** from that swing-high close. From the 2026-10-21 local peak close of 2470.77, the drawdown is **-27.5%**.

**Weekend microstructure caveat:** 2026-11-14 is a **Saturday**. Crypto weekend books are materially thinner, and the prior weekend sessions show the pattern — 2026-11-08 (Sunday) closed -5.15% (2272.73 → 2120.98) on just 8.34B volume, and 2026-11-01 (Sunday) printed only 4.88B. A -7% Saturday close on a 173-point range should be read as a **thin-book liquidation cascade**, not as institutional repricing. That distinction matters for how much of the move you chase versus fade.

---

## 3. Trend framework: a fully bearish MA stack with a fresh death cross

**The stack (all verified 2026-11-14):**

| Average | Value | Price vs. average |
|---|---:|---:|
| 10 EMA | 2047.34 | **-12.45%** |
| VWMA (vol-weighted) | 2140.12 | **-16.25%** |
| 200 SMA | 2144.74 | **-16.43%** |
| Bollinger middle (20 SMA) | 2189.36 | **-18.13%** |
| 50 SMA | 2395.75 | **-25.19%** |

The ordering **Price (1792.42) < 10 EMA (2047.34) < VWMA (2140.12) ≈ 200 SMA (2144.74) < 50 SMA (2395.75)** is textbook bearish alignment. Critically, the **VWMA (2140.12) and the 200 SMA (2144.74) sit within $5 of each other** — this is the single heaviest overhead supply confluence in the chart, and it is roughly **19.5%** above the current close.

**Two structural breaks in the last three sessions that deserve attention:**

- **10 EMA crossed below the 200 SMA on 2026-11-12** (2143.18 vs 2149.10 that day; on 2026-11-11 it was still above at 2171.26 vs 2150.87). This is a fast-moving "death cross" on the short-term horizon and confirms the trend has moved from correction to impulse.
- **The 200 SMA has rolled over.** It peaked at **2159.11 on 2026-10-29** and has declined in each of the **10 sessions since 2026-11-05** (2156.64 → 2144.74). The long-term regime filter has flipped from up to down. The 50 SMA has been declining since mid-October (from 2556.17 on 2026-10-11 to 2395.75). Note that the 50 SMA remains *above* the 200 SMA, so a formal golden/death cross has not yet occurred — but the gap is compressing rapidly and price has already broken beneath both.

**VWMA is the most useful of the four for confirming the quality of the decline.** Volume-weighted cost basis at 2140.12 means the average ETH holder who transacted over the past ~20 sessions is deeply underwater and sitting on ~19.5% of pain. That produces overhead supply on every rally into 2140–2145, and it is the level I would use to define "the relief rally," not the 50 SMA.

---

## 4. Momentum: stretched, but *not* exhausted — and the October precedent matters

**RSI: 20.41.** Deeply oversold; this is the lowest reading in the entire 45-session lookback window (previous 30-day floor: 30.29 on 2026-10-30). Contextually, RSI spent October oscillating between ~30 and ~46 while price fell from 2470 to 2241 — i.e., RSI ~20 is unusually low *for this regime*, not just low in absolute terms.

**MACD: -127.30, Signal: -92.56, Histogram: -34.74.** The MACD line has been below zero continuously since 2026-10-11 (Oct 10: +3.23 → Oct 11: -2.07), so the negative regime is a month old, not new. The histogram tells the acute story: it turned negative between 2026-11-07 (+1.06) and 2026-11-08 (-6.31) and has widened relentlessly since — -6.31 → -9.37 → -15.39 → -17.37 → -19.53 → -24.85 → **-34.74**.

**This is the single most important nuance in the report: the MACD histogram extreme does NOT mark the price low.** In October, the histogram bottomed at **-36.68 on 2026-10-10** — essentially the same reading as today (-34.74) — yet price kept falling for another **14 sessions** and **9.3% lower** (2470.77 on 2026-10-21 → 2241.05 on 2026-10-30) before the MACD line itself bottomed (-70.90 on 2026-10-31). Today's histogram reading is therefore a *warning of ongoing downside volatility*, not a buy signal.

**Divergence check — negative result, stated plainly:** RSI made a new cycle low on 2026-11-14 (30.57 on 11-11 → 30.57... precisely: 30.57 on 11-11, 28.66 on 11-12, 24.84 on 11-13, 20.41 on 11-14) and the histogram made a new cycle low (-34.74) on the same bar that price made a new low (1760.05). **Neither oscillator is diverging.** A bullish divergence is the specific evidence required before fading this move, and it does not yet exist.

**The constructive counterpoint:** the fact that RSI can reach 20 (versus a ~30 floor for the past month) means the selling is now being done at a materially different intensity profile, and the 2026-11-14 candle closed with a 173-point range — the signature of a **capitulation/absorption bar** rather than an orderly decline. But one capitulation bar does not constitute a bottom. The tell will be the *next* bar: if price retests 1760.05–1792.42 and closes higher while RSI holds above 20, absorption is confirmed.

---

## 5. Volatility: expansion, not contraction

**ATR: 100.78 (5.62% of price), up from 78.86 on 2026-11-03 — a 27.8% expansion in eight sessions.** Volatility expansion accompanying directional downside is the technical definition of a trend regime rather than a range.

**Bollinger position:** close 1792.42 vs lower band 1878.16 (**price is 4.57% below the lower band**), middle 2189.36, upper 2500.55. Bandwidth is 28.4% of the middle line — wide. Closing *through* the lower band is a continuation signal, not a reversal signal, in a trending tape; the statistically normal behavior of a band-walk is for the band itself to descend toward price.

**Implication for stops:** with ATR at 100.78 and the 2026-11-14 range at 173.04 (1.72× ATR), any stop placed inside 1× ATR of entry is inside noise and will be swept. Stops need to sit at **1.5–2× ATR (151–202 points)** from entry, or the position must be sized down accordingly.

---

## 6. Volume: elevated, but not capitulation-grade

2026-11-14 volume of **16.31B** is roughly **1.5× the prior 29-session average (~10.8B)**. Volume has expanded alongside the decline (2026-10-29: 18.83B, 2026-10-30: 20.04B, 2026-11-04: 17.49B, 2026-11-05: 18.67B, 2026-11-13: 15.32B, 2026-11-14: 16.31B) — **rising volume into falling price = distribution, confirmed.**

However, and this matters for position sizing: **16.31B is not a panic print by ETH-USD's own standards.** Comparable capitulation sessions in the series ran far heavier — 97.74B (2025-10-10), 76.83B (2025-11-04), 64.998B (2026-02-05), 60.38B (2026-02-05). Today's volume is roughly **one-sixth to one-fifth** of those. The downtrend is being driven by *persistent, grinding supply*, not a final liquidation flush. That argues for **not** sizing a mean-reversion trade as though a bottom is imminent.

---

## 7. Key levels map

**Support (descending):**
- **1760.05** — 2026-11-14 intraday low. Immediate.
- **1748.63** — 2026-02-06 low (the Feb 2026 swing low). Only **-2.44%** below the close. This is the first *structural* level and the one that matters most for the next few sessions.
- **1717.80** — 2026-06-04 low.
- **1638.25 / 1563.78** — 2026-06-23 and 2026-06-07 lows.
- **1540.16 / 1506.51** — 2026-06-05 and 2026-06-06 lows: the June 2026 capitulation floor, ~**-16%** from the close. This is the line in the sand for the bear case.

**Resistance (ascending):**

- **1927.41 / 1933.09** — 2026-11-14 open / high. Reclaim = first sign of a technical bounce.

- **2120.98** — 2026-11-08 close.

---

## 8. Actionable scenarios

### Scenario A — Continuation short (highest base rate: the trend is intact and momentum is still expanding)
**Trigger:** daily close below **1760.05**, which opens **1748.63** (Feb 2026 low) and then the **1717.80 → 1638 → 1563** ladder.
**Entry:** on a failed reclaim of 1760.05, or on the close below it.
**Stop:** above **1878.16** (lower band) → 85.74 points (**4.78%** risk). Tighter alternative above **1933.09** (today's high) → 140.67 points (7.85%).
**Targets:** 1748.63 (1R-ish), 1638.25 (~2R), 1506.51 (major).
**Rationale:** no bullish divergence, histogram at cycle extreme with no deceleration, 10 EMA below 200 SMA, 200 SMA rolling over, price below the VWMA by 16.25%.

### Scenario B — Capitulation / mean-reversion long (counter-trend; small size only)
**Trigger — all three required, in order:**
1. RSI holds **above 20** and prints a **higher low** vs the 2026-11-14 reading while price retests 1760–1792 (this creates the bullish divergence that does not yet exist);
2. A daily **close back above 1878.16** (the lower band);
3. Ideally, the MACD histogram **contracts** for 2+ consecutive sessions while price holds.

**Entry:** 1850–1880 zone on confirmation.
**Stop:** below **1760.05** (and ideally below 1748.63) → ~85–130 points (**4.6–7.0%**). Because ATR is 100.78, do not use less than 1.5× ATR (151 pts) of stop distance.
**Targets:** 2005.43 → 2047.34 (10 EMA) → 2120.98.
**Sizing:** half size or less. Rationale: today's volume (16.31B) is far below ETH-USD's true capitulation prints (60–98B), so the flush may not be finished; and the October precedent shows the histogram extreme preceded a further 9.3% leg down.

### Scenario C — Confirmed trend reversal (long; wait for it, do not anticipate it)
**Trigger:** daily close **above 2144.74 / 2140.12** (200 SMA + VWMA confluence) with the 50 SMA flattening and the MACD histogram flipping positive.
**Entry:** on the reclaim/retest of 2140–2145.
**Stop:** below the 10 EMA / swing low after the reclaim.
**Targets:** 2189.36 → 2395.75.
**Rationale:** in a bear trend, rallies into the falling 200 SMA are sell zones; a close above it is the first structural evidence the bear is over. Until then, every bounce is a lower high in a downtrend.

### What would invalidate the bear case (check these weekly)
- RSI printing a bullish divergence (higher low vs 1760.05) while price holds above 1748.63;
- Daily close above **1878.16**, then **2047.34**;
- MACD histogram contracting while price is flat-to-higher (momentum divergence);
- Volume on down days contracting below ~9B while up days exceed ~15B (seller exhaustion);
- Daily close above **2144.74** (200 SMA + VWMA).

---

## 9. Risk management (ATR-anchored, since ATR = 5.62% of price)

- **Position sizing formula:** units = (account risk %) ÷ ATR. At ATR 100.78, risking 1.0% of equity means size = 0.01 × equity ÷ 100.78. At a 5% risk, size = 0.05 × equity ÷ 100.78.
- **Stops:** minimum 1.5× ATR (≈151 points) from entry for any swing position; 2× ATR (≈202 points) for a multi-day hold given the 173-point range printed on 2026-11-14.
- **Short from 1792.42** with a stop above 1933.09: risk 140.67 points (7.85%). With a stop above 1878.16: risk 85.74 points (4.78%). The 2:1 reward-to-risk versions target 1885/2075 and 1964/2122 respectively — both of which still sit *below* the 2140–2145 supply wall, so the trade is structurally sound (targeting into mid-range rather than into the confluence).
- **Long from 1850–1880 with a stop below 1760.05:** risk ≈90–120 points (5–6.5%); first meaningful target 2005.43 gives roughly 1:1, extended target 2047.34 gives roughly 1:1.5. Given the weak asymmetry, keep size small.
- **Because 2026-11-14 is a Saturday session:** expect thinner liquidity and wider weekend wicks. Do not size weekend positions on the assumption that the 100.78 ATR will hold; weekend ATR expansion of 20–30% is routine.

## ETH-USD sentiment report (2026-11-07 to 2026-11-14)

**Bottom line:** The only available substantive source, StockTwits, leans bearish for ETH-USD, with especially forceful downside language and a sense of buyer frustration. The result is directionally bearish but not a high-conviction, broad-market reading: confidence is low because Yahoo Finance news and Reddit were unavailable.

### 1. Source-by-source breakdown

**StockTwits — Bearish**
- The classifier read **16 ETH-USD posts as 4 bullish, 9 bearish, 2 neutral, and 1 unclear**. That is **56.25% bearish versus 25% bullish**, a bearish-to-bullish ratio of **9:4** across all on-topic posts, including unlabeled messages.
- Among the displayed messages that carry user labels, there are **3 bullish, 5 bearish, and 8 unlabeled** posts. The labeled sample is therefore **62.5% bearish versus 37.5% bullish** (5:3). The larger all-post classifier tally is the more useful signal because it evaluates on-topic posts whether or not the author supplied a label.
- The sample is not merely mildly negative. Bearish messages include complaints that downside is being compressed at roughly 5% daily, claims that large holders are selling, predictions of much lower prices, the assertion that “longs are dead” and “no one” is buying, and one extreme expectation that ETH-USD will eventually reach zero. Another message argued that ETH-USD is losing appeal as a “store of value” and “inflation hedge.” These are opinionated retail claims, not verified events.
- The bullish minority was also notable: one user said they were not selling, another said they had bought more and could average down, and one considered adding 30 tokens. One unlabeled post noted that futures were “rip’n,” while another reacted with “nothing’s changed and yet this?” These messages suggest that dip buying and some expectation of a rebound remain present.
- Importantly, the unlabeled messages are not neutral in content. Several express capitulation, confusion, or continued downside expectations, so discarding them would understate the bearish tone. At the same time, the sample is small and clustered near the end of the observation window, limiting how much weight it can carry.

**Yahoo Finance news — Unavailable**
- The news feed failed with a Yahoo Finance `YFDataException`; no configured vendor could provide the headlines.
- This is **missing data, not evidence of a bearish, bullish, or quiet institutional-news environment**. No institutional framing, verified catalyst, or macro-news comparison can be established from the supplied evidence.

**Reddit — Unavailable**
- The fetch failed for **r/ethereum, r/CryptoCurrency, and r/CryptoMarkets**.
- This is **not an absence of discussion**, and no conclusions can be drawn about holder sentiment, broader crypto-community tone, or engagement. No subreddit-specific comparison is possible.

### 2. Cross-source divergences and alignments

A genuine cross-source divergence test is not possible because only StockTwits returned data. Consequently, there is **no valid conclusion** about institutional sentiment versus retail sentiment, nor about whether ETH-USD retail positioning is unusually bullish or bearish relative to the wider market. The bearish reading is aligned only across the classifier tally and the manually labeled StockTwits subset; it should not be presented as a confirmed cross-market consensus.

### 3. Dominant narrative themes

1. **Downside continuation and capitulation:** Multiple posts focus on persistent losses, lower lows, “longs are dead,” and the belief that selling will continue.
2. **Buyer frustration with dip buying:** Some users describe repeatedly buying declines, averaging down, or planning to hold, but frame that behavior defensively rather than confidently. One post says they are done trying to buy dips.
3. **Large-holder selling and rotation:** Posts allege that large amounts are being sold and suggest capital is rotating into technology stocks because those assets are viewed as having more value. These are unverified social-media assertions.
4. **Challenge to ETH-USD’s store-of-value narrative:** Sarcastic references to “inflation hedge,” “safe and secure,” and “store of value” suggest dissatisfaction with ETH-USD’s investment-thesis framing.
5. **A limited counter-narrative of bottom-fishing:** Buying more, averaging down, not selling, and strength in futures indicate that some participants expect stabilization or a rebound.

### 4. Catalysts and risks surfaced by the data

**Potential near-term positive signals, all unconfirmed:**
- Continued dip buying and averaging down could cushion declines.
- Some holders’ commitment not to sell suggests underlying holder loyalty.
- The comment about futures strength could indicate a short-term rebound or renewed speculative activity.

**Downside and positioning risks, also unconfirmed:**
- The dominant posted narrative expects further downside rather than a durable reversal.
- Claims of large-holder selling and capital rotation imply continued supply.
- Extreme bearish targets—such as the references to $800 or zero—are indicators of fearful retail rhetoric, not credible forecasts or verified technical levels.
- If the dip-buying bids weaken as the author of one post suggests, downside sentiment could become more entrenched.

No verified product launch, protocol upgrade, macroeconomic event, institutional flow, earnings event, or regulatory catalyst appears in the supplied data. Such information would require the unavailable news feed and cannot be inferred from social posts.

### 5. Key sentiment signals

| Signal | Direction | Source | Supporting evidence |
|---|---|---|---|
| Overall on-topic retail stance | Bearish | StockTwits classifier | 9 bearish, 4 bullish, 2 neutral, 1 unclear across 16 ETH-USD posts |
| User-labeled post stance | Bearish | StockTwits labels | 5 bearish vs. 3 bullish among 8 labeled posts; 8 additional posts unlabeled |
| Downside/capitulation rhetoric | Strongly bearish | StockTwits message bodies | “longs are dead,” “no one buying,” persistent-lower-price comments, and an expectation of a much lower ETH-USD |
| Dip-buying/holding conviction | Moderately bullish | StockTwits message bodies | Posts saying “not selling,” “just bought more,” and considering adding tokens |
| Large selling and rotation narrative | Bearish | StockTwits message bodies | Claims of large amounts being sold and capital moving toward technology stocks; not independently verified |
| ETH-USD investment-thesis skepticism | Bearish | StockTwits message bodies | Sarcastic references to “store of value,” “inflation hedge,” and “safe and secure” |
| Short-term futures tone | Mildly bullish but tentative | StockTwits message bodies | One unlabeled post says ETH-USD futures are “rip’n” |
| Institutional/news framing | Unknown | Yahoo Finance | Feed unavailable due to request failure; no directional inference |
| Broader Reddit sentiment | Unknown | Reddit | Fetch failed for all three listed subreddits; not evidence of silence |

**Assessment:** ETH-USD sentiment is **Bearish (3.2/10)**, but with **low confidence**. The retail sample is clearly negative in aggregate, yet the absence of news and Reddit prevents validation against institutional and community sources. This is a sentiment signal for traders to weigh alongside fundamentals and technicals—not a standalone price forecast or trade recommendation.

The prediction-market evidence is high-quality and internally consistent, but it describes *market-implied distributions*, not fundamentals. **Any ETH-specific catalyst (protocol upgrade, staking/validator event, ETF flow shock, exploit, regulatory action) is invisible to this report and must be checked on your own news terminal before sizing.**

**Critical technical note on market construction:** All ETH and BTC markets read *"dip to X / reach X by December 31, 2026."* These are **path-based (touch) markets — they price the distribution of the path minimum and maximum, NOT the Dec 31 closing price.** A 90% "dip to $1,750" means a 90% chance ETH trades at or below $1,750 at *some point* in the remaining ~6.5 weeks, not a 90% chance it closes there.

## 8. Company/Protocol Profile & Background

**Ethereum** is a public, permissionless, global computing platform. Its native asset `ETH-USD` (Ethereum USD, venue code CCC) functions simultaneously as (a) the gas token paying for computation and data storage, (b) the settlement collateral layer for DeFi, and (c) the staking asset securing consensus.

**Established protocol history relevant to the current tape:**
- **Proof-of-Stake transition ("The Merge," September 15, 2022):** replaced proof-of-work mining with a validator-based consensus model, cutting energy costs dramatically and converting issuance into a staking-driven process. This structurally created the *net issuance vs. burn* tug-of-war described in §7.1.
- **EIP-1559 (London, August 2021):** introduced a dynamic base fee with automatic burning, giving ETH a recurring deflationary mechanism tied to network demand. Burn is the variable most sensitive to a post-rollup world.
- **EIP-4844 ("Dencun", March 2024):** introduced data blobs and separated data-availability cost from execution, sharply lowering rollup costs and accelerating L2 migration — which mechanically **reduces base-layer burn**.
- **Pre-mined supply of ~30M ETH** was allocated to the original ICO participants and the Ethereum Foundation in 2015, with multi-year lockups and public sale price floors that still anchor the "fair value" conversation.
- **Ongoing roadmap items** (proto-danksharding, further blob-price and scaling adjustments, and related consensus work) are best understood through their effect on **burn rate and validator economics** rather than through transaction throughput headlines.

**What a trader must internalize:** ETH has **no cash flow to the holder** and **no contractual claim on the protocol's economics**. Holder value accrues through (1) fee burn reducing float, (2) staking yield, and (3) the store-of-value / collateral premium from network demand. When the burn mechanism weakens and staking yield compresses — plausible in a 30–38% drawdown with L2 migration — the *fundamental floor* softens materially. **The 200-day MA at $2,147 has no cash-flow anchor beneath it.** That is the core risk in this asset and the reason position sizing must be conservative.
